```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nathanielcross04/MPP-Capstone/refs/heads/main/Data/Final%20data/state_distances%20(raw%20and%20deltas).csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

YEARS       <- 2000:2019
DELTA_YEARS <- 2001:2019

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CUSTOM CELL ANNOTATIONS
# Format: "StateName__YYYY" = "Your note here"
# These appear appended to the auto-generated tooltip for that cell.
# EDIT: add or remove entries as needed. Uncomment examples below to try.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
annotations <- list(
  # "Louisiana__2006" = "Post-Katrina displacement effects",
  # "New York__2002"  = "Post-9/11 policy shifts"
)

# ── Extract series ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_series <- function(prefix, years) {
  cols    <- paste0(prefix, "_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0(prefix, "_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(
    years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
    states = df$state,
    values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.numeric(mat[i, ]))
  )
}

extract_clusters <- function(years) {
  cols    <- paste0("cluster_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0("cluster_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(
    years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
    states = df$state,
    values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.integer(mat[i, ]))
  )
}

# ── Build payload ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
payload <- list(
  # Primary table slices
  global_raw          = extract_series("dist_1cs",             YEARS),
  global_raw_delta    = extract_series("dist_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  global_ranked       = extract_series("rank_1cs",             YEARS),
  global_ranked_delta = extract_series("rank_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  own_raw             = extract_series("dist_own",             YEARS),
  own_raw_delta       = extract_series("dist_own_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  own_ranked          = extract_series("rank_own",             YEARS),
  # own_ranked_delta intentionally omitted — columns don't exist in data
  ext_raw             = extract_series("extremity",            YEARS),
  ext_raw_delta       = extract_series("extremity_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  ext_ranked          = extract_series("rank_extremity",       YEARS),
  ext_ranked_delta    = extract_series("rank_extremity_delta", DELTA_YEARS),
  clusters            = extract_clusters(YEARS),
  # Cross-reference slices for tooltips
  all_dist_1cs        = extract_series("dist_1cs",             YEARS),
  all_rank_1cs        = extract_series("rank_1cs",             YEARS),
  all_delta_1cs       = extract_series("dist_1cs_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  all_dist_own        = extract_series("dist_own",             YEARS),
  all_rank_own        = extract_series("rank_own",             YEARS),
  all_delta_own       = extract_series("dist_own_delta",       DELTA_YEARS),
  all_extremity       = extract_series("extremity",            YEARS),
  all_rank_ext        = extract_series("rank_extremity",       YEARS),
  all_delta_ext       = extract_series("extremity_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  annotations         = annotations
)

json_payload <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6, na = "null")
```

<div id="tbl-outer">

</div>

<!-- ── TOOLTIP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div id="cell-tooltip"></div>

<!-- ── LIBS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.0.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/fixedcolumns/4.3.0/js/dataTables.fixedColumns.min.js"></script>

<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EDIT: colour constants
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const CLUSTER_COLORS = { "1": "#B5463A", "2": "#2E86B5" };
const EXTREMES_CLOSE = "#009E73";   // EDIT: closest states color
const EXTREMES_FAR   = "#D55E00";   // EDIT: furthest states color
const N_TOP          = 3;           // EDIT: number of extremes highlighted

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EDIT: subtitle strings
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const SUB_MEASURE = {
  global:    "Euclidean distance of each state from the overall centroid across all states and years.",     // EDIT
  own:       "Euclidean distance of each state from the centroid of its assigned cluster.",                 // EDIT
  extremity: "How far each state sits from the centre of the full distribution — a measure of uniqueness." // EDIT
};

const SUB_TRANSFORM = {
  raw:          "Raw distance values for each year (2000–2019).",                                                                      // EDIT
  raw_delta:    "Year-over-year change in raw distance (2001–2019). Positive = moving away; negative = moving closer.",                // EDIT
  ranked:       "States ranked by distance each year (2000–2019). Lower rank = closer to centroid.",                                  // EDIT
  ranked_delta: "Year-over-year change in rank (2001–2019). Negative = improved (moved closer); positive = worsened."                 // EDIT
};

const SUB_COLOR = {
  global: {
    none:          "No highlighting applied.",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership.",
    extremes:      "The 3 closest (green) and 3 furthest (orange) states each year are highlighted.",
    top1:          "The single closest state each year is highlighted with a bubble. Bubble color reflects cluster.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fill applied; the closest state each year carries a white bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Extremes highlighted; the single closest state each year carries a bubble."
  },  // EDIT any of the strings above
  own: {
    none:          "No highlighting applied.",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership.",
    extremes:      "The 3 closest states per cluster each year are filled using that cluster's color.",
    top1:          "The single closest state per cluster per year carries a bubble in that cluster's color.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fill applied; the closest state per cluster per year carries a white bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Closest 3 per cluster highlighted; the single closest per cluster carries a bubble."
  },  // EDIT any of the strings above
  extremity: {
    none:          "No highlighting applied.",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership.",
    extremes:      "The 3 most extreme (furthest) states each year are highlighted in orange.",
    top1:          "The single most extreme state each year carries a bubble. Bubble color reflects cluster.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fill applied; the single most extreme state each year carries a white bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Top 3 most extreme highlighted; the single most extreme state carries a bubble."
  }  // EDIT any of the strings above
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STATE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let curMeasure   = "global";
let curTransform = "raw";
let curColor     = "none";
let dtInstance   = null;

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COLOUR HELPERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function hexToRgb(hex) {
  return [
    parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16)/255,
    parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16)/255,
    parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)/255
  ];
}
function rgbToHex(r,g,b) {
  return '#' + [r,g,b].map(v =>
    Math.round(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v))*255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')
  ).join('');
}
function lighten(hex, amount) {
  const [r,g,b] = hexToRgb(hex);
  return rgbToHex(r+amount*(1-r), g+amount*(1-g), b+amount*(1-b));
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SORT / INDEX HELPERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function rowAvg(arr) {
  const v = arr.filter(x => x !== null && !isNaN(x));
  return v.length ? v.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/v.length : Infinity;
}
function rowAvgAbs(arr) {
  const v = arr.filter(x => x !== null && !isNaN(x));
  return v.length ? v.reduce((a,b)=>a+Math.abs(b),0)/v.length : Infinity;
}
function nSmallest(arr,n) {
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v).slice(0,n).map(x=>x.i);
}
function nLargest(arr,n) {
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v!==null&&!isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v).slice(0,n).map(x=>x.i);
}
function nSmallestAbs(arr,n) {
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v:Math.abs(v),i})).filter(x=>!isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v).slice(0,n).map(x=>x.i);
}
function nLargestAbs(arr,n) {
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v:Math.abs(v),i})).filter(x=>!isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v).slice(0,n).map(x=>x.i);
}
// All indices tied for global min/max (handles ties for Top 1)
function allMinIdx(arr) {
  const valid = arr.filter(v=>v!==null&&!isNaN(v));
  if (!valid.length) return [];
  const mn = Math.min(...valid);
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v===mn).map(x=>x.i);
}
function allMaxIdx(arr) {
  const valid = arr.filter(v=>v!==null&&!isNaN(v));
  if (!valid.length) return [];
  const mx = Math.max(...valid);
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>x.v===mx).map(x=>x.i);
}
function allMinAbsIdx(arr) {
  const valid = arr.filter(v=>v!==null&&!isNaN(v));
  if (!valid.length) return [];
  const mn = Math.min(...valid.map(Math.abs));
  return arr.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).filter(x=>Math.abs(x.v)===mn).map(x=>x.i);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SPARKLINE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildSparkline(vals, globalMin, globalMax) {
  // EDIT: W and H control sparkline dimensions in pixels
  const W = 90, H = 30, PAD = 3;
  const range = globalMax - globalMin || 1;
  const pts = vals.map((v,i) => {
    if (v === null || isNaN(v)) return null;
    const x = PAD + (i / Math.max(vals.length-1,1)) * (W - PAD*2);
    const y = H - PAD - ((v - globalMin) / range) * (H - PAD*2);
    return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (pts.length < 2) return `<svg width="${W}" height="${H}"></svg>`;
  return (
    `<svg width="${W}" height="${H}" style="display:block;overflow:visible">` +
    // EDIT: stroke color and width of sparkline
    `<polyline points="${pts.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="#2E86B5" ` +
    `stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>` +
    `</svg>`
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HIGHLIGHTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function computeHighlights(colVals, clustVals, measure, isDelta, colorMode) {
  const highlights = new Map();
  let closeIdx = new Set(), farIdx = new Set(), top1Idx = new Set();

  if (measure === "own") {
    const clusters = [...new Set(clustVals.filter(c=>c!==null))];
    clusters.forEach(cl => {
      const inCl = colVals.map((v,i)=>({v,i}))
        .filter(x => clustVals[x.i]==cl && x.v!==null && !isNaN(x.v))
        .sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v);
      inCl.slice(0, N_TOP).forEach(x => closeIdx.add(x.i));
      if (inCl.length) {
        const mn = inCl[0].v;
        inCl.filter(x=>x.v===mn).forEach(x=>top1Idx.add(x.i));
      }
    });

  } else if (measure === "extremity") {
    if (!isDelta) {
      nLargest(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i=>farIdx.add(i));
      allMaxIdx(colVals).forEach(i=>top1Idx.add(i));
    } else {
      nSmallestAbs(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i=>closeIdx.add(i));
      allMinAbsIdx(colVals).forEach(i=>top1Idx.add(i));
    }

  } else {
    // global
    if (!isDelta) {
      nSmallest(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i=>closeIdx.add(i));
      nLargest(colVals,  N_TOP).forEach(i=>farIdx.add(i));
      allMinIdx(colVals).forEach(i=>top1Idx.add(i));
    } else {
      nSmallestAbs(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i=>closeIdx.add(i));
      nLargestAbs(colVals,  N_TOP).forEach(i=>farIdx.add(i));
      allMinAbsIdx(colVals).forEach(i=>top1Idx.add(i));
    }
  }

  colVals.forEach((_, ri) => {
    const cl    = clustVals ? String(clustVals[ri]) : null;
    let cellBg  = null;
    let bubbleBg = null;

    // Cell background
    if (colorMode === "clusters" || colorMode === "clusters_top1") {
      if (cl && CLUSTER_COLORS[cl]) cellBg = CLUSTER_COLORS[cl];
    }
    if (colorMode === "extremes" || colorMode === "extremes_top1") {
      if (measure === "own") {
        if (closeIdx.has(ri) && cl && CLUSTER_COLORS[cl]) cellBg = CLUSTER_COLORS[cl];
      } else if (measure === "extremity") {
        if (farIdx.has(ri))   cellBg = EXTREMES_FAR;
        if (closeIdx.has(ri)) cellBg = EXTREMES_CLOSE;
      } else {
        if (closeIdx.has(ri)) cellBg = EXTREMES_CLOSE;
        if (farIdx.has(ri))   cellBg = EXTREMES_FAR;
      }
    }

    // Bubble — uniform size; color logic:
    const isTop1 = top1Idx.has(ri) &&
      (colorMode==="top1"||colorMode==="clusters_top1"||colorMode==="extremes_top1");
    if (isTop1) {
      if (colorMode === "clusters_top1") {
        // cell fill already shows cluster; use white bubble
        bubbleBg = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
      } else {
        // Top 1 only, or Extremes + Top 1:
        // bubble color = lightened cluster color of that state
        bubbleBg = (cl && CLUSTER_COLORS[cl])
          ? lighten(CLUSTER_COLORS[cl], 0.5)
          : "#eeeeee";
      }
    }

    if (cellBg || bubbleBg) highlights.set(ri, { cellBg, bubbleBg });
  });

  return highlights;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TOOLTIP
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function ordinal(n) {
  if (n===null||isNaN(n)) return "—";
  const s = Math.round(n);
  const sfx = ["th","st","nd","rd"];
  const v = s % 100;
  return s + (sfx[(v-20)%10]||sfx[v]||sfx[0]);
}
function sgn(v) { return v >= 0 ? "+" : ""; }

function getVal(slice, si, yr) {
  const yi = slice.years.indexOf(yr);
  if (yi<0||si>=slice.values.length) return null;
  return slice.values[si][yi];
}

function buildTooltip(state, year) {
  const yr = parseInt(year);
  const si = RAW_DATA.global_raw.states.indexOf(state);
  if (si < 0) return "";

  // Cluster for this year
  const cyi     = RAW_DATA.clusters.years.indexOf(yr);
  const cluster = (cyi>=0 && si<RAW_DATA.clusters.values.length)
    ? RAW_DATA.clusters.values[si][cyi] : null;

  let lines = [];

  if (curMeasure === "global") {
    const raw   = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_dist_1cs,  si, yr);
    const rank  = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_1cs,  si, yr);
    const delta = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_1cs, si, yr);
    if (raw   !== null) lines.push(`Distance: ${raw.toFixed(4)}`);
    if (rank  !== null) lines.push(`Rank: ${ordinal(rank)} of 50`);
    if (delta !== null) lines.push(`Δ prior year: ${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`);
  } else if (curMeasure === "own") {
    const raw   = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_dist_own,  si, yr);
    const rank  = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_own,  si, yr);
    const delta = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_own, si, yr);
    if (raw   !== null) lines.push(`Cluster distance: ${raw.toFixed(4)}`);
    if (rank  !== null) lines.push(`Within-cluster rank: ${ordinal(rank)}`);
    if (delta !== null) lines.push(`Δ prior year: ${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`);
  } else {
    const raw   = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_extremity, si, yr);
    const rank  = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_rank_ext,  si, yr);
    const delta = getVal(RAW_DATA.all_delta_ext, si, yr);
    if (raw   !== null) lines.push(`Extremity: ${raw.toFixed(4)}`);
    if (rank  !== null) lines.push(`Rank: ${ordinal(rank)} of 50`);
    if (delta !== null) lines.push(`Δ prior year: ${sgn(delta)}${delta.toFixed(4)}`);
  }

  if (cluster !== null) lines.push(`Cluster: ${cluster}`);

  const annNote = RAW_DATA.annotations && RAW_DATA.annotations[`${state}__${yr}`];
  let html = `<div class="tt-title">${state} — ${yr}</div>`;
  html += lines.map(l=>`<div>${l}</div>`).join("");
  if (annNote) html += `<div class="tt-note">&#128204; ${annNote}</div>`;
  return html;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BUILD TABLE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildTableData() {
  const key = curMeasure === "extremity"
    ? "ext_" + curTransform
    : curMeasure + "_" + curTransform;

  const slice    = RAW_DATA[key];
  const clustDat = RAW_DATA.clusters;
  if (!slice) return null;

  const states   = slice.states;
  const years    = slice.years;
  const isDelta  = curTransform.includes("delta");
  const isRanked = curTransform.includes("ranked");
  const vals     = slice.values;

  // Shared sparkline scale
  let gMin = Infinity, gMax = -Infinity;
  vals.forEach(row => row.forEach(v => {
    if (v!==null&&!isNaN(v)) { if(v<gMin) gMin=v; if(v>gMax) gMax=v; }
  }));

  // Cluster year map
  const cym = {};
  clustDat.years.forEach((yr,ci) => { cym[yr]=ci; });

  // Per-column highlights
  const colHL = years.map((yr,yi) => {
    const cv = vals.map(r=>r[yi]);
    const ci = cym[yr];
    const clv = ci!==undefined
      ? clustDat.values.map(r=>r[ci])
      : new Array(states.length).fill(null);
    return computeHighlights(cv, clv, curMeasure, isDelta, curColor);
  });

  // Sort order: avg ascending (closest first)
  // Extremity non-delta: avg descending (most extreme first)
  const avgs = vals.map(row =>
    (curMeasure==="extremity"&&!isDelta) ? -rowAvg(row)
    : isDelta ? rowAvgAbs(row)
    : rowAvg(row)
  );
  const order = avgs.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v).map(x=>x.i);

  const rows = order.map(si => {
    const state = states[si];
    const row = [
      `<div class="cv">${state}</div>`,
      `<div class="spark-cell">${buildSparkline(vals[si], gMin, gMax)}</div>`
    ];
    years.forEach((yr,yi) => {
      const raw = vals[si][yi];
      const hl  = colHL[yi].get(si);
      const disp = (raw===null||raw===undefined||isNaN(raw)) ? ""
        : isRanked ? (Number.isInteger(raw) ? String(raw) : raw.toFixed(1))
        : raw.toFixed(4);

      const da = `data-state="${state}" data-year="${yr}"`;
      if (!hl) {
        row.push(`<div class="cv" ${da}>${disp}</div>`);
      } else {
        const bg  = hl.cellBg  ? `background:${hl.cellBg};`  : "";
        const fg  = hl.cellBg  ? "color:#fff;"                : "";
        if (hl.bubbleBg) {
          row.push(
            `<div class="cv" style="${bg}${fg}" ${da}>` +
            `<span class="bubble" style="background:${hl.bubbleBg};color:#222;">${disp}</span>` +
            `</div>`
          );
        } else {
          row.push(`<div class="cv" style="${bg}${fg}" ${da}>${disp}</div>`);
        }
      }
    });
    return row;
  });

  return { years, rows };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RENDER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function render() {
  document.getElementById("sub-measure").textContent   = SUB_MEASURE[curMeasure]     || "";
  document.getElementById("sub-transform").textContent = SUB_TRANSFORM[curTransform] || "";
  document.getElementById("sub-color").textContent     = (SUB_COLOR[curMeasure]||{})[curColor] || "";

  const result = buildTableData();
  if (!result) {
    document.getElementById("tbl-wrapper").innerHTML =
      '<p style="color:#c00;padding:1rem;">Not available for this combination.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const { years, rows } = result;
  const columns = [
    { title: "State", orderable: true  },  // EDIT: column header label
    { title: "Trend", orderable: false }   // EDIT: sparkline column header label
  ].concat(years.map(y => ({ title: String(y), orderable: true })));

  if (dtInstance) {
    dtInstance.destroy();
    document.getElementById("tbl-wrapper").innerHTML =
      '<table id="main-dt" class="display"></table>';
  }

  dtInstance = $('#main-dt').DataTable({
    data:     rows,
    columns:  columns,
    paging:   false,
    searching: false,
    info:     false,
    ordering: true,
    order:    [],
    scrollX:  true,
    fixedColumns: { leftColumns: 2 },
    columnDefs: [
      { targets: 0, width: "130px", className: "dt-left",   orderable: true  },
      { targets: 1, width: "100px", className: "dt-left",   orderable: false },
      { targets: "_all", className: "dt-center", width: "70px" }
    ],
    dom: 't',
    createdRow: function(row) { $(row).find('td').css('padding','0'); }
  });

  attachTooltips();
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TOOLTIP EVENTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function attachTooltips() {
  const tip = document.getElementById("cell-tooltip");
  $(document).off("mouseenter mousemove mouseleave", ".cv[data-state]");

  $(document).on("mouseenter", ".cv[data-state]", function(e) {
    const html = buildTooltip(this.dataset.state, this.dataset.year);
    if (!html) return;
    tip.innerHTML = html;
    tip.style.display = "block";
    positionTip(e);
  });
  $(document).on("mousemove", ".cv[data-state]", function(e) { positionTip(e); });
  $(document).on("mouseleave", ".cv[data-state]", function() {
    tip.style.display = "none";
  });
}
function positionTip(e) {
  const tip = document.getElementById("cell-tooltip");
  const tw = tip.offsetWidth||240, th = tip.offsetHeight||100;
  let x = e.clientX+14, y = e.clientY+14;
  if (x+tw > window.innerWidth -10) x = e.clientX-tw-10;
  if (y+th > window.innerHeight-10) y = e.clientY-th-10;
  tip.style.left = x+"px"; tip.style.top = y+"px";
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BUTTON HANDLERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function setMeasure(btn) {
  curMeasure = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-measure .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b===btn));
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
}
function setTransform(btn) {
  if (btn.classList.contains("disabled")) return;
  curTransform = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b===btn));
  render();
}
function setColor(btn) {
  curColor = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-color .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b===btn));
  render();
}

function enforceConstraints() {
  const rdBtn = document.querySelector('[data-val="ranked_delta"]');
  if (curMeasure === "own") {
    rdBtn.classList.add("disabled");
    if (curTransform === "ranked_delta") {
      curTransform = "raw_delta";
      document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
        .forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.val===curTransform));
    }
  } else {
    rdBtn.classList.remove("disabled");
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INIT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
$(document).ready(function() {
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
});
</script>
